caption.zh: 核心机制：发送者准备两条消息 → 接收者选择一个位置 → 接收者只得到其中一条，发送者不知道选哪条。OT 同时保护两件事：接收者不泄露选择，发送者不泄露另一条消息。
caption.en: Core mechanism: The sender prepares two messages → The receiver chooses one position → The receiver learns one message; the sender learns nothing about the choice. OT protects both sides: the receiver's choice stays secret and the sender's other message stays hidden.

alt.zh: 三栏编号示意图：第 1 栏「发送者准备两条消息」；第 2 栏「接收者选择一个位置」；第 3 栏「接收者只得到其中一条，发送者不知道选哪条」。底部是阅读提示。
alt.en: Three numbered panels: panel 1 “The sender prepares two messages”; panel 2 “The receiver chooses one position”; panel 3 “The receiver learns one message; the sender learns nothing about the choice”. A reading note sits at the bottom.

caption.zh: 边界三栏：提供什么、不提供什么、不要混入什么。OT 的边界。
caption.en: Three boundary columns: what it gives, what it does not give, and what not to mix in. Boundaries of OT.

alt.zh: 绿色「提供」列：1-out-of-2 消息传输；接收者选择隐私；MPC 的基础原语。黄色「不提供」列：不是通用加密；不提供身份认证；不自动保证恶意安全。红色「不要混入」列：把 OT 当普通密钥交换；忽略半诚实与恶意模型区别；把一条消息的传输当成两条都保密。
alt.en: Green “GIVES” column: 1-out-of-2 message transfer; Receiver-choice privacy; A base primitive for MPC. Amber “DOES NOT GIVE” column: Is not general encryption; Does not provide authentication; Does not automatically guarantee malicious security. Rose “DO NOT MIX IN” column: Treating OT as ordinary key exchange; Ignoring semi-honest versus malicious models; Assuming both messages stay secret when only one is transferred.

zh.principle: **算法**：不经意传输（Oblivious Transfer）。1-out-of-2 OT 中，发送者持有 m0 与 m1，接收者持有选择位 b；协议结束时接收者得到 m_b，但发送者不知道 b，接收者也得不到 m_{1-b}。Rabin 的原始版本是“抛硬币式”OT：接收者以一半概率得到秘密。Even–Goldreich–Lempel 后来给出更常用的 1-out-of-2 形式。构造通常基于公钥加密、陷门置换或格假设。
zh.why: OT 是安全多方计算的“乘法门”：有了 OT，双方可以在不泄露输入的情况下计算电路。它也是隐私集合求交、 oblivious database access、密钥交换和隐私机器学习的基础。没有 OT，很多 MPC 协议只剩理论上的存在性。按“输入 → 状态 → 变换 → 输出 → 判据”复述机制；每一步都要能指出谁执行、改变什么、留下什么证据。无法指出证据的步骤，只能标为待核，不能写成已复现。
zh.used: 隐私集合求交（PSI）、隐私查询、联邦学习、阈值签名、通用 MPC 协议。工程上常用半诚实 OT 扩展成大量 OT，再配合 cut-and-choose 或认证机制抵抗恶意方。
zh.broken: OT 的安全性取决于模型：半诚实模型只保证不主动作弊的参与方；恶意模型需要额外验证。接收者可能试图同时得到两条消息，发送者可能替换消息；不加认证的 OT 不能证明对方身份。实现中的选择偏差、时序和重放也会破坏隐私。### 形式模型
zh.history:

en.principle: **Algorithm**: Oblivious Transfer (不经意传输). In 1-out-of-2 OT the sender holds m0 and m1, and the receiver holds a choice bit b. At the end the receiver learns m_b; the sender learns nothing about b, and the receiver learns nothing about m_{1-b}. Rabin's original version was a “coin-flip” OT in which the receiver obtains the secret with probability one half. Even–Goldreich–Lempel later gave the more common 1-out-of-2 form. Constructions use public-key encryption, trapdoor permutations or lattice assumptions.
en.why:
OT is the multiplication gate of secure multi-party computation: with OT, two parties can evaluate a circuit without revealing their inputs. It also underpins private set intersection, oblivious database access, key exchange and privacy-preserving machine learning. Without OT, many MPC protocols remain mere existence proofs.

Restate the chain as input → state → transform → output → criterion. Every step should identify who acts, what changes and what evidence remains. A step without evidence is marked unverified, not reproduced.
en.used:
Private set intersection (PSI), private queries, federated learning, threshold signatures and general MPC. Implementations often extend a few base OTs into many, then add cut-and-choose or authentication against malicious parties.

en.broken:
Security depends on the model: semi-honest OT only protects parties that do not actively cheat; the malicious model needs extra verification. A receiver may try to obtain both messages, and a sender may substitute messages; unauthenticated OT does not prove identity. Choice bias, timing and replay can also break privacy.

en.history:
Rabin proposed “oblivious transfer” in a 1981 technical report, initially as coin-flip transfer. Even, Goldreich and Lempel gave 1-out-of-2 OT in 1985; it then became a base primitive for MPC. Most practical MPC frameworks today start from OT extension rather than building every gate from scratch.
